alt_text: Four panels comparing vep-rs v0.6.0 and fastVEP v0.5.0 against Ensembl VEP 116.2. (a) Raw F1 per dataset as a bar for each of vep-rs and fastVEP, with each tool's adjusted F1 as a marker joined to the end of the bar by a line where the two differ. (b) Wall time per dataset and architecture of vep-rs, fastVEP and Ensembl VEP, a circle each, filled for ARM and open for x86; from left to right, the circles of every dataset and architecture are those of vep-rs, fastVEP and Ensembl VEP; each wall-time cell of Ensembl VEP holds 1 run, against 5 for vep-rs and fastVEP. (c) Raw F1 per plugin (plugins verified on real data; TranscriptAnnotator on its committed table; plugins whose data cannot be redistributed on synthetic fixtures, marked synthetic) as a bar for each of vep-rs and fastVEP, with each tool's adjusted F1 as a marker joined to the end of the bar by a line where the two differ: fastVEP has a figure on 14 of the 57 rows, its marker on 12 of them, and a cross (no such source) on 43; vep-rs's adjusted F1 is exactly 1 on 57 of the 57 rows. (d) The plugins read by vep-rs and fastVEP, a bar each: 31 of 31 and 7 of 31. A marker standing at the end of its bar means that the tool's raw and adjusted F1 are equal as drawn. On a row of a plugin verified on real data, vep-rs's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage), except on gnomADMt GRCh38 (ClinVar alone); fastVEP's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage). The plugin panel's 57 rows carry 32 row names for 31 plugins: CADD is scored under CADD and CADD (structural variants). A row's figure is summed over the sets of the row that the record holds for the tool, and the tools differ in them on 4 rows: dbNSFP GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 5, fastVEP 1), dbNSFP GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 9, fastVEP 1), SpliceAI GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1) and SpliceAI GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1). An F1 of exactly 1 has no place on a scale of 1 - F1: it is drawn where the axis reads 1, past a break in the axis line, and 66 of the 66 adjusted markers of vep-rs stand there. The plugin panel runs over both columns: its groups from Committed table on continue in the second column, under the same title.
caption: **vep-rs v0.6.0 against Ensembl VEP 116.2, with fastVEP v0.5.0 as comparator.** (a) Raw F1 per dataset on a log(1 - F1) axis; a marker is its tool's adjusted F1, joined to the end of its bar by a line where the two differ. All six is the pool of the six whole-genome datasets, the ClinVar and the population datasets. (b) Wall time per dataset and architecture: a ClinVar line is the median of its runs, any other the sum of its dataset's cell medians (the record's methodology note: "a dataset's figure is the sum of its per-chromosome medians"); each wall-time cell of Ensembl VEP holds 1 run, against 5 for vep-rs and fastVEP. (c) Raw F1 per plugin: plugins verified on real data; TranscriptAnnotator on its committed table; plugins whose data cannot be redistributed on synthetic fixtures, marked synthetic. On a row of a plugin verified on real data, vep-rs's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage), except on gnomADMt GRCh38 (ClinVar alone); fastVEP's counts are summed over the genome-wide ClinVar dataset of the row's genome build and whole-genome population datasets of that build (GRCh37: gnomAD v2.1.1 and 1000 Genomes Phase 3; GRCh38: gnomAD v4.1 and 1000 Genomes high-coverage). The bar is each tool's per-feature raw F1, the marker its tool's adjusted F1, joined to the end of its bar by a line where the two differ, as in (a); a cross marks a plugin for which the comparator has no counterpart ("no such source"). LoFTEE's reference ran with stand-ins for the MaxEntScan files its module bundles, on the Ensembl VEP image with samtools added. (d) The plugins each tool reads, of the 31 that vep-rs supports: vep-rs 31 and fastVEP 7; plugins vep-rs does not port are not counted and are listed by reason in the README. The plugin panel's 57 rows carry 32 row names for 31 plugins: CADD is scored under CADD and CADD (structural variants). A row's figure is summed over the sets of the row that the record holds for the tool, and the tools differ in them on 4 rows: dbNSFP GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 5, fastVEP 1), dbNSFP GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 9, fastVEP 1), SpliceAI GRCh37 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1) and SpliceAI GRCh38 synthetic (vep-rs 4, fastVEP 1). On an F1 axis a value is a place, not a length: every bar starts at the left edge of its plot, left of where an F1 of 0 stands, and ends at the place of its F1. A marker standing at the end of its bar means that the tool's raw and adjusted F1 are equal as drawn. On a comparator's adjusted F1 the record's note reads: "The adjusted figure sets aside the same documented classes as for vep-rs; where the engine produces none of their shapes it equals the raw one." fastVEP's adjusted F1 is left out where no record holds its adjusted counts. An F1 of exactly 1 has no place on a scale of 1 - F1: it is drawn where the axis reads 1, past a break in the axis line, and 66 of the 66 adjusted markers of vep-rs stand there. vep-rs matches Ensembl VEP exactly except for the documented divergences. Every value is in the records listed under Provenance records.
